Lauren (External auditor): Hi Redwood team — for SOC 2 review we need keystore/KMS evidence covering 2025-10-01 through 2025-12-31. Deliverables: (1) access log export with user, action, key_id, timestamp; (2) HSM chain-of-custody entries and signatures; (3) reproducible playbook and artifacts for INC-2025-472 (503s during rotation). Prefer a single S3 archive with manifest + sha256. Who can own?

marta.security: I'll coordinate. We'll prepare a tarball with CSV logs, manifest.json, sha256, manifest.sig, and a short reproducibility doc. Targeting 48 hours. sha256 ok?

Lauren (External auditor): sha256 fine. Also include KMS key IDs used for exports, the exact CLI commands executed, and a signed statement of who performed the export with timestamps.

kevin.eng: I will run the exporter and assemble files. Planned path:
- s3://redwood-compliance/exports/keystore-20251001_20251231/
- manifest.json with file list, per-file sha256, run_by and host metadata
- manifest.sig signed by HSM-OP-03
I'll post the live S3 paths when uploaded.

jonathan.sre: Note the KMS key used by the exporter: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/77aa88bb-ccdd-11ee-9911-223344556677. Export requires two approvers per runbook RB-2025-701 (console confirm + OTP). I'll export the RB audit trace and include it in the package.

kate.support: For INC-2025-472 summary: during a rolling key rotation the rollout sequence left a narrow timing window where auth-cache nodes validated against stale material, causing intermittent 503s for long-tail tokens. We have a staging sim that reproduces the timing.

kevin.eng: Repro playbook (to include verbatim):
1) set staging env
   export RW_ENV=staging
   export ROTATE_SLEEP=50
2) deploy legacy auth-cache as canary
   ./scripts/run-auth-cache --version=2025-10-12-legacy --port=7105
3) start rotation simulator
   ./tools/rotate-sim --key ff77aa88-ccdd-11ee --window ${ROTATE_SLEEP} --env=staging
4) generate concurrent requests
   for i in $(seq 1 300); do curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer <staging-token>" https://staging.redwood.internal/v1/generate -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n"; sleep 0.05; done

Sample redacted log lines (production slice):
   2025-11-22T03:14:05Z rotation:start key=ff77aa88 run_id=rb-701-2025
   2025-11-22T03:14:09Z auth-cache: miss token_hash=sha256:deadbeef... proxied->legacy
   2025-11-22T03:14:09Z api: response=503 path=/v1/generate trace=trc-9f8a
We expect very low percent (<<0.1%) 503s during rotation.

marta.security: Exact CLI commands to produce the export (to include in manifest):
aws s3 sync s3://prod-logs/keystore/ s3://redwood-compliance/exports/keystore-20251001_20251231/ --profile redwood-audit
tar -C /tmp/exports -czf keystore-20251001_20251231.tar.gz keystore-20251001_20251231
sha256sum keystore-20251001_20251231.tar.gz > keystore-20251001_20251231.sha256
pkcs11-tool --module /usr/lib/softhsm/libsofthsm2.so --login --keypairgen --label HSM-OP-03 --sign --in manifest.json --out manifest.sig

audit-bot: Evidence package uploaded: s3://redwood-compliance/exports/keystore-20251001_20251231/keystore-20251001_20251231.tar.gz
Manifest: s3://redwood-compliance/exports/keystore-20251001_20251231/manifest.json
Signature: s3://redwood-compliance/exports/keystore-20251001_20251231/manifest.sig
sha256: a9c8f7e6d5c4b3a2f1e0d9c8b7a6f5e4d3c2b1a0987654321fedcba9876543210
Signed-by: HSM-OP-03

Lauren (External auditor): I can access and verify the signature. Please provide the IAM principals and approvers for RB-2025-701 and a signed run statement with timestamps.

jonathan.sre: Runbook RB-2025-701 audit export attached to the same location. Run performed by kevin.eng@redwood, approved by marta.security@redwood and ops-lead@redwood (Vault OTP). Service principal role/keystore-export-role. I'll include the RB export tar.gz in the archive.

kate.support: We'll include three redacted production trace slices with token hashes and trace IDs for cross-reference. Customer IDs will be replaced with acct-XXXX placeholders.

marta.security: Chain-of-custody PDF will state:
- manifest created and checksummed
- archive uploaded to locked S3 path with SSE-KMS using arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/77aa88bb...
- manifest signed with HSM-OP-03 and timestamped
- runbook export attached (RB-2025-701)
All signatures scanned and embedded in the PDF.

Lauren (External auditor): One last detail: retention policy for exported bundles and raw keystore logs?

marta.security: Exported SOC2 artifacts: retention 7 years. Raw keystore logs: 3 years hot, then 4 years archived to Glacier (total 7). Policy ref: arn:aws:s3:::redwood-compliance/policies/SOC2-RETAIN-7YR

Lauren (External auditor): Thanks, that's everything for initial review. We'll follow up if the review team needs clarifications.

kevin.eng: Thanks all. Archive live and linked. Closing our tasks. Ping if anything missing. :white_check_mark:

audit-bot: Runbook export attached: RB-2025-701/export-1765433000.tar.gz -> s3://redwood-compliance/exports/runs/RB-2025-701/export-1765433000.tar.gz
